general.title: Panel Settings
general.description: Port this panel listens on, and how it looks.

port.label: Panel Port
port.help: The HTTP port the panel's web interface listens on.
port.context: Change this if port 3001 conflicts with another service on this machine. You'll need to restart the panel and update your bookmark/URL afterward.
port.hint: Port used to access the panel (default: 3001).

restart.message: Port changes require a restart. Save first, then restart.

startup.title: Startup
startup.description: Control whether the panel launches automatically.
startup.startDescription: Launch the panel automatically when you log in.
startup.startHelp: Creates a Windows Task Scheduler entry that launches the panel when you log in.
startup.startContext: The panel runs as a normal (non-elevated) process. A console window will appear on login — close it to stop the panel.
startup.autoStartEnabledMessage: The panel will start automatically when you log in to Windows.
startup.autoStartDisabledMessage: The panel will no longer start automatically.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeDescription: Choose between the gritty survival look or a clean light theme.
appearance.themeHelp: Switches the panel's color scheme between the dark 'Survival' look and a clean light theme.
appearance.themeContext: Purely cosmetic — pick whichever is easier on your eyes. Applies instantly, no restart or save needed.

connection.title: RCON Connection
connection.description: Test the connection and set reconnect behavior. Host, port, and password are configured per-server on the Servers page.
connection.autoReconnectDescription: Automatically retries the RCON connection if it drops.
connection.autoReconnectHelp: Automatically retries the RCON connection if it drops.
connection.autoReconnectContext: Keeps the panel talking to your server without manual intervention after network blips or server restarts.
connection.reconnectIntervalHelp: How long the panel waits between RCON reconnect attempts.

https.title: HTTPS
https.description: Encrypt panel traffic with a TLS certificate.
https.recommendedHelp: Enable HTTPS, leave certificate paths empty, save, then restart.
https.recommendedContext: The panel creates a local self-signed certificate automatically.
https.enableHttpsHelp: Serves the panel's web interface over encrypted HTTPS instead of plain HTTP.
https.enableHttpsContext: Recommended for most setups, especially if you access the panel outside your local network. Leave certificate paths empty to use an auto-generated self-signed cert.
https.httpsPortHelp: The port the panel listens on for HTTPS connections.
https.httpsPortContext: 3443 is fine for most setups. Change it only if that port is already in use or your reverse proxy expects a different port.
https.customCertificatePathHelp: Path to your own TLS certificate file, if you have one from a CA like Let's Encrypt.
https.customCertificatePathContext: Only needed if you don't want the panel's auto-generated self-signed cert (which browsers flag as untrusted). Must be paired with a matching key path.
https.customCertificatePathHint: Set both certificate and key paths, or leave both empty.
https.customKeyPathHelp: Path to the private key file that matches your custom certificate.
https.customKeyPathContext: Must be set together with Custom Certificate Path — leave both empty to use the panel's auto-generated certificate instead.
https.customKeyPathHint: Supports PEM key files that Node.js can read.
https.partialCertPathMessage: Set both certificate and key paths, or clear both to use auto-generated certs.
https.autoGeneratedMessage: The panel will create and reuse a local self-signed certificate.
https.reverseProxyMessage: If TLS is terminated by Nginx, Caddy, or Cloudflare Tunnel, keep panel HTTPS off and proxy local HTTP.
https.restartMessage: HTTPS changes require restart. Save first, then restart from Panel Settings.

access.title: Remote Access (CORS)
access.description: Controls which devices and browsers can connect to this panel. If you only access the panel from this machine, these defaults are fine.
access.quickStart: Quick Start for VPS Remote Access
access.quickStartStep2: Add one origin per line in the list below (example: http://YOUR_PUBLIC_IP:3001).
access.quickStartStep3: Save settings, then click Reload CORS Rules.
access.allowPrivateLANDescription: Automatically allow connections from localhost and private/LAN IP ranges.
access.allowPrivateLANHelp: Automatically trusts browser requests coming from localhost and private/LAN IP ranges.
access.allowPrivateLANContext: Keep this on for typical home/LAN setups. Turning it off can lock you out of the panel from other devices on your network until you add their origin manually below.
access.showPublicIPDescription: Look up this machine's public IP (via api.ipify.org) to display on the dashboard. Off by default — an unnecessary external dependency and small privacy leak for LAN-only setups. The result is cached, so this calls out at most once per restart.
access.showPublicIPHelp: Looks up and displays this machine's public IP address on the dashboard.
access.showPublicIPContext: Purely cosmetic convenience for sharing your server's address with players. Off by default to avoid the external lookup call and minor privacy leak for LAN-only setups.
access.dashboardLANAddressDescription: Which network interface's address the dashboard shows. Useful when this host has more than one, e.g. Tailscale and ZeroTier at once — pick the one you actually want to share with players.
access.dashboardLANAddressHelp: Which of this machine's network interface addresses the dashboard displays to you.
access.dashboardLANAddressContext: Display-only — has no effect on CORS or who can actually connect. Auto-detect works for most single-NIC setups; pick manually if you run Tailscale, ZeroTier, or multiple network adapters.
access.originsDescription: List of additional origins that are allowed to access this panel.
access.originsHelp: Enter one origin per line. Requests from these origins will be allowed through CORS.

security.title: Security & Authentication
security.description: Change your password and review access details.
security.passwordMinimum: Password must be at least 6 characters.
security.recoveryCodesDescription: Use these codes to regain access if you lose your authenticator app.

updates.title: Panel Auto Update
updates.description: Check for a new release, download it, then apply on restart.

about.title: About
about.description: Panel version, runtime info, and helpful links.
about.aboutDescription: A web-based management panel for Project Zomboid dedicated servers. Includes RCON, player management, mod update detection, scheduled restarts, world backups, Discord integration, and the PanelBridge Lua mod for in-world actions.
about.supportDescription: Support development to keep updates and new features coming.
about.builtWith: Built with React, Node.js, and Socket.IO
